scene: Inside the inflatable fortress, bouncy columns hum with soft neon lights.
picture: Pixel art side-view of a bouncy fortress interior along a flat squishy floor. Left hangs a purple rope ladder reaching down from above. The dark-haired boy in green stripes stands near it holding his skateboard. Centre sits a glowing cube pedestal. Far right shows a shut vinyl door with an oversized zipper.
shown: a dangling purple rope ladder hanging down up high on the left
a glowing square pedestal with a floating pixel cube at centre
a massive yellow zipper closed tight along a doorway on the right
